name: accordo
description: The open-source framework coding agents use to build custom CRMs: domain modules, deterministic workflows, human approvals, audit and trace.

interface.shortDescription: Build a custom CRM as code you own
interface.longDescription: Accordo is the open-source framework coding agents use to build custom CRMs. Describe a commercial process and the agent generates domain modules, deterministic workflows, human approval boundaries, audit and trace — as reviewable code in your own repository. Pre-release: local SQLite, no authentication or tenancy.
interface.defaultPrompt: Read AGENTS.md, then run `npm run crm -- app inspect --json` and tell me which parts of my commercial process this project already supports and which it does not
